records.title: CoGenesis: A Framework Collaborating Large and Small Language Models for Secure Context-Aware Instruction Following
records.reason: CoGenesis coordinates hosted large and local small LMs for privacy-aware generation, but evaluates quality/privacy workflow, not speculative-decoding speed or throughput.
